subject: Working with Woven & others
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

We've recently started working with Woven, Wayve, and Oxa - so thought it could be interesting to reach out to explore if we can help at [COMPANY] in a similar way.

The common challenges these teams faced were around existing data visualisation / curation solutions (e.g. Voxel51 & internal tools), lacking the speed, scalability, & multi-modal support required to efficiently visualise their datasets.

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support searching through billions of data points (across LiDAR, Radar, & Video) enabling AV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning from working with Woven, Wayve, Oxa and similar partners in the space.

Would it be worth us connecting?

subject: Fine-tuning Nudge & Dwell
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

Really enjoyed Chandhu's talk at Nvidia GTC & noticed you were also currently hiring for CV Engineers - seems like fine-tuning Nudge and rolling out Dwell to more locations is likely to be a key focus for the team this year?

Many of the leading Retail CV teams we work with (Standard AI, Trax Retail, Trigo etc) complained that fine-tuning models for new stores was frustratingly slow and expensive - given bottlenecks in coordinating between CV teams and their third-party annotation partners. 

At Encord we've built a scalable data management solution that brings together data curation & annotation in a single platform, freeing teams from administrative burdens & removing bottlenecks in model fine-tuning - an approach which has helped Standard AI to save $600k/year. 

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning from working with Standard AI, Trax Retail, Trigo and similar partners in the space.

Would it be worth us connecting?
